subject.title: Improve macOS onboarding UX and gateway setup

question: Should this stale protected PR be closed as superseded by current main, or should the contributor rebase a narrow remainder onto the Crestodian/local Gateway onboarding architecture?
rationale: The branch overlaps later merged maintainer work, still has P1 security/compatibility findings and missing real proof, and carries a protected label, so automation should not choose the product/ownership outcome.

options.title: Close as superseded
options.body: Close this PR after maintainer review because current main already took the local Gateway and Crestodian onboarding direction and the remaining branch would need substantial replacement.

options.title: Request narrow rebase
options.body: Ask the contributor to rebase only still-useful UI copy or tests, dropping the old wizard/probe/gate changes and adding live macOS proof.

options.title: Keep as broad candidate
options.body: Keep the PR open only if maintainers intentionally want this branch to own a broader onboarding direction despite current-main overlap and security fixes required.

recommendation.title: Close as superseded
recommendation.body: Close this PR after maintainer review because current main already took the local Gateway and Crestodian onboarding direction and the remaining branch would need substantial replacement.

likelyOwner.reason: He owns the current-main replacement path through the merged local Gateway setup and Crestodian onboarding PRs.
